second_read.note: Journal = arXiv v3 to every digit. Eq. (13)/(15): H in Hartree with Ewald sum and a background constant; simple cubic simulation cell with PBC, plane waves k = 2πn/L (Gamma). Convention: the paper's quoted BF-DMC column equals arXiv:0801.0518's Ha values with Madelung (e.g. 0.52989(4) at rs = 1), and the MP-NQS energies sit below QMBL's HF (-0.002331 Ha/e) by plausible correlation energies. N_up = N_dn = 64 is an open shell at Gamma in the sc cell (cumulative shells 57, 81); this does not affect a variational or fixed-node total energy, only E_c rows (RULES 12.3). VMC with the paper's own MP-NQS -> variational; how the final energy and its bar were estimated (final-state evaluation vs averaged training iterations) is not stated (C6/C7).
